hero.name: Juan Cristo
hero.bio: Welcome to my block! Just as a well-planned city relies on efficient transit lines, structured road systems, and resilient infrastructure, I build reliable, scalable software applications and performant systems.

projects.title: Projects District
projects.subtitle: Explore some of my latest projects and discover where I focus my efforts and skills. Each project was conceived as a fundamental building block of a city.

items.title: NBA FANtastic
items.description: API providing selected NBA data on historical players, records, and active players. Currently implementing a prediction system.

items.title: Radio UENF
items.description: Official website for Radio UENF, an extension and institutional project from UENF

items.title: Eventos UENF
items.description: Official website for Eventos UENF, created to centralize all university events inside UENF.

items.title: Cheap Tracker
items.description: Logistics and route optimization system whose primary objective is to find the most cost-effective and shortest path for a delivery route with multiple destinations.

items.title: Magical Lineup
items.description: Line up creator for soccer enthusiasts, with share to social media options, multi-language support and offline-first mentality.

stack.title: Stack Park
stack.subtitle: Step into the city's open technology park. Just as trees and gardens bring a breath of fresh air to the urban landscape, these programming languages, frameworks, and foundations are essential to my software creations.
